questions.q: In which year was A. P. J. Abdul Kalam honoured with the Bharat Ratna?
questions.solution: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, the missile scientist and 11th President of India, was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1997. **Answer: 1997**
questions.shortcut: 1997 was India's 50th year of independence — Kalam was honoured in that year.

questions.q: In September 2024, who has been appointed as the new director general of the Narcotics Control Bureau?
questions.solution: In September 2024, IPS officer Anurag Garg (1993 batch, Himachal Pradesh cadre) was appointed Director General of the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB). **Answer: Anurag Garg**

questions.q: In June 2025, which foreign brand unveiled footwear inspired by Kolhapuri chappals which sparked accusations of 'cultural misappropriation'?
questions.solution: At its June 2025 Milan menswear show, Italian luxury house Prada showed sandals nearly identical to the GI-tagged Kolhapuri chappals, sparking accusations of cultural misappropriation; Prada later acknowledged the inspiration. **Answer: Prada**

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0, approved in August 2024 aims to provide housing subsidies to which group?
questions.solution: PMAY-U 2.0, approved by the Union Cabinet in August 2024, targets urban poor and middle-class families (EWS/LIG/MIG households) with interest subsidies and support for affordable housing. **Answer: Urban poor and middle-class families**

questions.q: Which of the Indian state/union territory achieved 1st rank in India Electric Mobility Index 2024?
questions.solution: Delhi secured the first rank in NITI Aayog's first India Electric Mobility Index (IEMI) 2024, which scores states and UTs on EV adoption, charging infrastructure and policy support. **Answer: Delhi**

questions.q: The Kadbanwadi grassland is in____________.
questions.solution: The Kadbanwadi grassland lies in Indapur tehsil of Pune district, Maharashtra, and is known as a habitat of the Indian grey wolf. **Answer: Maharashtra**

questions.q: Who is the author of the book 'The Namesake'?
questions.solution: 'The Namesake' (2003), a novel about a Bengali immigrant family and questions of identity, was written by Jhumpa Lahiri. **Answer: Jhumpa Lahiri**

questions.q: 'Bengbung', a Mizo indigenous instrument, is similar to which instrument?
questions.solution: Bengbung is a Mizo indigenous instrument of bamboo slats struck with sticks, so it resembles the xylophone. **Answer: Xylophone**

questions.q: Which traditional puppet dance of Tamil Nadu depicts scenes from the Ramayana and the Mahabharata?
questions.solution: Bommalattam is the traditional puppet dance/show of Tamil Nadu; its performances commonly depict episodes from the Ramayana and the Mahabharata. **Answer: Bommalattam**

questions.q:
Which of the following is an example of artificial satellites?

I. Sputnik-I

II. GSAT-I
questions.solution: Sputnik-I (USSR, 1957 — the first artificial satellite) and GSAT-I (India's communication satellite, launched 2001) are both man-made (artificial) satellites. **Answer: Both I and II**

questions.q: -What is the change of state from liquid to solid at atmospheric pressure known as?
questions.solution: The change of state from liquid to solid at atmospheric pressure is solidification (freezing); deposition is gas to solid, and sublimation is solid to gas. **Answer: Solidification**
questions.shortcut: Two traps to remember: gas→solid = deposition, solid→gas = sublimation.

questions.q:
Which of the following is correct regarding law of conservation of energy?

I. Energy can only be converted from one form to another.

II. Energy can be easily destroyed.
questions.solution: By the law of conservation of energy, energy can neither be created nor destroyed; it only changes from one form to another. So only statement I is correct. **Answer: Only I**

questions.q: The 'ossification test' is used to determine the__________. of a person.
questions.solution: The ossification test examines bone and cartilage fusion (e.g. at the elbow, wrist, joints) to estimate a person's age, commonly used in age-determination and juvenile justice cases. **Answer: Age**

questions.q: In August 2025, which technological breakthrough aims to reduce India's reliance on Chinese specialty fertilisers?
questions.solution: In August 2025, India developed its first indigenous water-soluble fertiliser process, aimed at reducing dependence on Chinese specialty fertiliser imports after China curbed such exports. **Answer: Water-soluble fertiliser process**

questions.q: In progressive income taxation___________.
options: higher income leads to a higher tax rate
everyone pays the same tax rate
lower income leads to a higher tax rate
higher income leads to a lower tax rate
questions.solution: Under progressive taxation the tax rate rises with income — higher income slabs attract higher rates, so the burden falls more on the well-off. **Answer: higher income leads to a higher tax rate**
questions.shortcut: 'Progressive' = rate progresses upward with income (opposite: regressive).

questions.q: The code on social security extends social security to__________.
questions.solution: The Code on Social Security, 2020 extends social security coverage to employees/workers in both the organised and the unorganised sector, including gig and platform workers. **Answer: organised or unorganised sector employee**

questions.q:
Shivaji's exploits against which forces made him a legendary figure?

I. Mughal

II. Bijapur
questions.solution: Shivaji built his reputation through campaigns against both the Adil Shahi Sultanate of Bijapur and the Mughal Empire. **Answer: Both I and II**

questions.q: In which year the SEBI formulated the 'Insider Trading Regulations'?
questions.solution: SEBI first formulated the insider trading regulations in 1992 under the SEBI Act, 1992; they were later replaced by the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. **Answer: 1992**

questions.q: The Vice President of India can be removed from office by__________.
options: Resolution passed by the Council of States and agreed to by the House of the People
Resolution passed by both Houses of Parliament with one-thirds majority
The President on the advice of the Prime Minister
questions.solution: Under Article 67(b), the Vice President can be removed by a resolution of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) passed by an effective majority and agreed to by the House of the People (Lok Sabha); there is no impeachment procedure. **Answer: Resolution passed by the Council of States and agreed to by the House of the People**
questions.shortcut: Only the Vice President (not President/Judges) is removed by a Rajya Sabha-initiated resolution — no impeachment.

questions.q: About what percentage of india's land are covered under plateau region?
questions.solution: India's relief divides roughly as: plains 43%, mountains 30% and plateaus 27% of the total land area. **Answer: 27%**

questions.q:
Land reforms introduced after the independence were successful in which of the following Indian state?

I. Kerala

II. West Bengal
questions.solution: Land reforms (tenancy reform, land ceilings) succeeded most notably in Kerala and West Bengal, where strong political will and tenant movements ensured effective implementation. **Answer: Both I and II**

questions.q: What was the share of industry in India's GDP in 1950-1951?
questions.solution: As per NCERT (Indian Economic Development), the industrial sector's share of GDP rose from 13% in 1950-51 to 24.6% in 1990-91. **Answer: 13%**

questions.q: In the context of population change, if the birth rate is________ than death rate, the population will__________.
questions.solution: When the birth rate is more than the death rate, natural growth is positive, so the population increases. **Answer: more, be increase**

questions.q: In humans, what is the value of normal systolic and diastolic blood pressure respectively?
options: 75 mm Hg and 60 mm Hg respectively
80 mm Hg and 70 mm Hg respectively
100 mm Hg and 95 mm Hg respectively
​120 mm Hg and 80 mm Hg respectively
questions.solution: Normal human blood pressure is about 120 mm Hg systolic over 80 mm Hg diastolic. **Answer: 120 mm Hg and 80 mm Hg respectively**
questions.shortcut: The standard 120/80 figure — systolic is always the higher value.

questions.q: In ancient India, the Mahajanapada of 'Anga' had its capital at which city in Bihar?
questions.solution: Anga, one of the 16 Mahajanapadas, had its capital at Champa (near modern Bhagalpur, Bihar). **Answer: Champa**
